queries_run: AI agents disrupt SaaS seat-based software Microsoft 365 Copilot threat 2026

findings.claim: MSFT FY2026 10-K 自述：多數業務進入門檻低、技術快速且具顛覆性演進；AI 產品與超大規模雲、開源及前沿模型供應商競爭（其中部分同時是夥伴），並點名 agentic computing 的重要性快速上升。
findings.excerpt: Barriers to entry in many of our businesses are low and many of the areas in which we compete evolve rapidly with changing and disruptive technologies, shifting user needs, and frequent introductions of new products and services.

findings.claim: 10-K 述及 AI 產品與 hyperscalers、開源產品及前沿模型供應商競爭，部分為現有或潛在夥伴。
findings.excerpt: Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, open-source offerings, and frontier model providers, some of which are also current or potential partners.

findings.claim: 部落格稱 AI agents（含 Copilot）壓縮 M365 生態 per-seat 收入。
findings.excerpt: Could AI Agents Break Per-Seat SaaS Pricing? A founder's view of how AI agents could change software interfaces, usage and pricing, grounded in what Microsoft is already doing with Copilot licensing.

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋僅得二手部落格（AI agent 對 per-seat SaaS 的衝擊評論，如 2026-02-03 SaaS 賣壓說法），無一手可逐字核實來源；未放入 findings。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
